title: Sizes & Prices
description: Ask for a clothing size and understand a simple price.
objectives: Ask for a clothing size and understand a simple price.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to ask for a clothing size and understand a simple price. The central language is what size/how much and number review. It belongs to the practical context of shopping & everyday english. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A1, keep the message short and concrete. One clear sentence is enough before the other person responds. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.title: Pattern
blocks.text: what size/how much and number review

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “What size do you need?” and “How much is this jacket?” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: what size/how much and number review.
